anchors.description: Right of the arched entrance stands a stainless-steel cylindrical litter bin with a black rectangular opening band near its top; height measured from the top cap down to the gravel contact at the base.
anchors.visible_evidence: Stainless cylinder is fully visible from top cap (near the brick pier) down to where it meets the gravel; pixel span is about 73 px and its width/height proportion (~0.4) matches a catalogue street litter bin (approx. 0.35 m diameter by 0.75-0.85 m body).
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact manufacturer/model unknown; cylindrical stainless bins of this type are sold in body heights of roughly 0.7-1.0 m, and a short pedestal or dome top could add a few centimetres.

anchors.description: The matching stainless-steel cylindrical bin at the left edge of the entrance (farther from the camera, in front of the low granite plinth); height from its top to its ground contact.
anchors.visible_evidence: Second bin of the same design and finish is visible on the left side of the doorway; its top rim and ground contact are both unobstructed, spanning about 56 px at a larger distance than the right-hand bin, consistent with the same physical height.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same model family assumed from identical stainless finish and proportions; if it is in fact a plain bollard the height would still fall in the same 0.8-1.0 m band.
